signIn.title: Welcome back
signIn.description: Sign in to your Sifty account.
signIn.passwordUpdated: Password updated. Sign in with your new password.
signIn.accountDeleted: Your account and all of its data have been deleted.

errors.INVALID_TOKEN: That link has expired or was already used. Sign in to get a new one.
errors.EXPIRED_TOKEN: That link has expired. Sign in to get a new one.
errors.account_not_linked: An account with this email exists but isn't confirmed yet. Sign in with your password or a sign-in link first; Google will work after that.

signUp.title: Create your account
signUp.description: Start with 30 days of Pro. No card up front; Free afterwards.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot your password?
forgotPassword.description: Enter your email and we will send you a link to choose a new one.
forgotPassword.sent: If an account exists for {email}, a reset link is on its way. It expires in one hour.

resetPassword.title: Choose a new password
resetPassword.invalidLink: This reset link has expired or was already used.
resetPassword.description: Other devices will be signed out once you save it.

form.magicLink: Email me a sign-in link instead

checkInbox.title: Check your inbox
checkInbox.verify: We sent a confirmation link to {email}. Open it to finish setting up your account.
checkInbox.magic: We sent a one-time link to {email}. Open it soon: it signs you in, confirms your address if that was still pending, or creates your account if you don't have one yet.

errors.emailNotVerified: Confirm your email first. We just sent you a fresh link.
errors.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters.
errors.invalidEmail: That doesn't look like an email address.
errors.userExists: An account with this email already exists. Sign in instead.
errors.invalidToken: That link has expired or was already used. Request a new one.
errors.noPassword: This account has no password yet. Use a sign-in link or Google, or set one via “Forgot password?”.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again in a minute.
errors.botDetected: Automated requests are not allowed here.
